summary: scripts/ci-local prints the setup and each stage's start, end and seconds, and the time each stage waited in the build admission queue, in a table at the end, and keeps each stage's output under ~/.cache/ci-local-logs/run-TIME-PID/ (latest 10 runs); the stage output is now one merged stream passed through unchanged apart from stamped queue lines.
